levels_defined.pilot-candidate: P0 + security + facts pass, restart and browser checked, no open critical/high defect, CODE_SHA/RUN.txt published

why_local_demo: P0 over HTTP on an isolated copy with a temp DB: 82/82 PASS incl. draft hidden, publish, deadline change with reason and preserved original, history, feedback pending->moderation->public reply, restart persistence, concurrency (one of two same-revision writes wins) — runs/r01-8c6add9.json.

P0 in a real browser (Chromium 141, 1440x900 and 390x844): editor login via form, draft via form (no raw JSON), publish, resident card with deadline/organisation 'нет данных'/synthetic banner/cost 'нет данных', date change with reason in history, F5 and real server restart, feedback with 'not official' receipt, moderation, reply visible, XSS payloads shown as text — runs/browser-r01-8c6add9.json (48 PASS / 5 FAIL / 1 NOT_RUN, after skeptic review).

Security over HTTP and in the browser: anonymous/CSRF/foreign Origin/wrong Host refused with state unchanged, logout revokes the server session, HttpOnly+SameSite=Strict cookie not visible to JS, role from body/headers/localStorage ignored, no runtime DB/.env/sources served, no server-side fetch of user URLs, login rate limit — S01-S14 PASS.

Facts: unknown budget/responsible shown as 'нет данных' (not 0) in API, card and assistant; assistant answers carry only dates present in the facts and are honestly labelled 'template' (no LLM configured) — runs/integrated-extra-8c6add9.json.
blocking_pilot_candidate: R10-D009 (high): the card's 'Задать вопрос по объекту' button text is invisible (contrast 1:1) at both sizes — the resident entry to the feedback step. One-selector patch verified (1.00 -> 14.79): patches/R03-cta-contrast.patch.
R10-D010 (medium): 409 conflict panel and its buttons hidden under the editor's sticky action bar at 1366/1440/390 (data is kept).
R01 has not published CODE_SHA/RUN.txt/DELIVERY.json (process D02).
Basemap and 3D could not be observed (OpenFreeMap blocked by the sandbox proxy): U06 basemap NOT_RUN; must be checked on a networked machine.
0 real Astana records: R05 could not fetch official sources; every object shown is synthetic and labelled so. A pilot needs verified real data.
not_production_ready: Local loopback server, local editor accounts via CLI, no SSO/IAM, no deployment hardening, no real data. Nothing here supports a public production claim.
